title: Curtis Fuller today
summary: They discover Fuller lives in New York and Tyner hopes to call him.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Do you know where Curtis Fuller is? (to Ken Kimery) Kimery: He’s living here.
Really? I haven’t seen Curtis in a while. So he’s living here? That’s good, I might give him a call one day. Kimery: I have his number.
Yeah I appreciate that, just to say hi. We go way back, that would be nice. I think I saw him once since he has been in town, but it’s been a while so I’d like to.
Because we were talking about the trombone with Ahmer.
Steve Turre, Curtis Fuller, any of them.
Yeah, our grandson, he likes trombone, he plays trombone in school. He would probably like to meet Curtis (laughs).
